local function AnimateBetaText()
    local text = "Version: Beta V2" -- The text to type

    local delayBetweenRepeats = 1 -- Adjust the delay between each repeat (in seconds)

    while true do

        TextLabel.TextTransparency = 1

        -- Type the characters one by one
        for i = 1, #text do
            TextLabel.Text = string.sub(text, 1, i) -- Set the text up to the current character
            TextLabel.TextTransparency = 0 -- Show the character
            wait(delayBetweenChars) -- Pause between typing each character
        end

        -- Clear the text
        TextLabel.Text = ""
    end
end

scripts.features: Autofarm wins
scripts.script:
game.Workspace.Finish.Teleporter.Name = "Teleporter1"
local fixedSpeed = 1400

local function startTweening()
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

    while true do
        wait()
        local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local finishSpawn = workspace.FinishSpawn.Position
        local teleporter = workspace.Finish.Teleporter.Position
        local teleporter1 = workspace.Finish.Teleporter1

        local function tweenToPosition(targetPosition)
            local distance = (character.PrimaryPart.Position - targetPosition).magnitude
            local duration = distance / fixedSpeed
            local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            local goal = {Position = targetPosition}
            
            local tween = TweenService:Create(character.PrimaryPart, tweenInfo, goal)
            tween:Play()
            tween.Completed:Wait()
        end
        
        wait(2)
        
        tweenToPosition(finishSpawn)
        
        wait(3)

        if teleporter1.Color == Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172) then
            tweenToPosition(teleporter1.Position)
        else
            tweenToPosition(teleporter.Position)
        end
    end
end

game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    startTweening()
end)

if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
    startTweening()
end

scripts.title: Don't Look Away: Frozen by Sight (Weeping Angel/SCP 173)
scripts.features:
Makes you unable to move whilst anyone's avatar is looking at you like the behaviour of the Weeping Angels from Doctor Who/SCP 173.

NOTE: If there are several players using this script together at once, You must not ever look at another player when using this script that is also using this script or you will both freeze permanently until someone else blocks your line of sight of each other or until an object blocks your line of sight of each other.

ALSO NOTE: If the script doesn't work/execute, try executing the loadstring yourself by pasting the loadstring into your executor.

This script was made by me, @quantuml0cked on roblox.
